project_name: SwasthSewa Call Centre AI Triage Console
archetype: Swiss Clinical Tactical & High-Contrast Operator Dashboard
target_audience: Call centre operators, health dispatch agents, medical triage supervisors
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Combine clinical urgency indicators with clean Swiss grid efficiency and modern developer API black-box tools
Emotion First: Calm clarity under pressure. High-contrast urgency badges prevent mistakes during emergency calls
Content & Narrative First: Real-time caller intake transitions effortlessly into AI reasoning, red flags, and nearby facility routing
Negative Space & Dense Clarity: High information density with crisp 1px borders, avoiding cramped, illegible forms
Contrast & Accessibility: APCA/WCAG compliant contrast for all urgency levels (Emergency, Urgent, Routine, Self-care)

Clinical Reasoning Summary (Generated by LLM black box)
Red-Flag Warning Indicators (Alert list with bullet points)
Recommended Facility Type (Tertiary Care / CHC / Primary Dispensary / Pharmacy)
Disclaimer Notice: 'System provides triage sorting & location guidance; not direct medical diagnosis.'
Sorted list of nearest facilities by distance (in km)
Facility Badge (Government Hospital / CHC / Mohalla Clinic / Private Dispensary)
Operating Hours & Emergency ER Availability Status
Direct Contact Phone & One-Click Directions Link (Google Maps format)

Live Response Payload Viewer with syntax highlighting
Response Time & Token Latency Metric Display

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or generic unstyled cards. Use clear 1px borders with subtle shadow.
Do NOT use #1B93A4 or #7351B7 as colors.
Provide Hindi and Hinglish voice intake simulation pre-fills to demonstrate real call centre usage in India.
Ensure high contrast for emergency badges so operators can read acuity levels instantly.
Use Sonner for toasts for dispatch notifications, copy events, and CSV imports.
Make sure the API black-box panel gives clear code examples (cURL, JavaScript, Python) showing how external applications consume the triage engine.
